notes: Independent control-site check (site_id in: IT-MBo, BE-Maa, AR-CCg) of P_F_QC polarity at MM and YY resolution, cross-checking FLUXMET P_F against ERA5 dataset's own P_ERA for bit-identity, binned by P_F_QC tier. Confirms higher P_F_QC = more measured (not the reverse), consistent with prior network-wide repo findings. IT-MBo included as a site previously examined in this repo at HH resolution (scripts/diagnostics/it_mbo_parsimony.R); remaining control sites are drawn from this project's own OSH/CSH/GRA/SAV/WSA candidate pool.
